name: BMP-SMAD-WNT4-FOXO1 decidual control
summary: BMP2 activates BMP-SMAD signaling, WNT4/beta-catenin and FOXO1-linked decidual differentiation; adding pathway states breaks the current progesterone alias chain.
evidence: direct human HESC perturbation plus patient-derived assembloid rescue
maboss: Promote S_BMP_SMAD and S_FOXO1 first; treat WNT4 as a high-confidence P1 extension and test exact logical ordering as variants.

name: IL11/LIF-STAT3-alpha2beta1 adhesion
summary: IL11 and LIF activate STAT3 and increase epithelial ECM adhesion; IL11 increases trophoblast-to-epithelium adhesion and both regulate integrin alpha2.
evidence: direct primary human epithelial functional experiments
maboss: Use X_IL11 and E_ITGA2B1 as a mechanistically identified non-SPP1 route; avoid replacing all cytokines with one anonymous redundancy relay.

name: SOX17 epithelial adhesion program
summary: SOX17 is hormone responsive at the receptive window and functional inhibition reduces trophoblast-spheroid adhesion.
evidence: direct human epithelial genetic and chemical perturbation
maboss: Add E_SOX17 as a redundant/rate-modifying positive route rather than a universal hard gate.

name: Surface glycosylation and sLeX
summary: FUT3/ST3GAL3-dependent sLeX contributes to trophoblast-endometrial adhesion and is regulated by receptive/inflammatory context.
evidence: human cell/tissue perturbation with mixed in-vivo support
maboss: Replace MUC1-specific permissive glycan assumption with a glycosylation-program plus E_SLEX_SURFACE abstraction.

name: Biochemical ECM ligand availability
summary: Fibronectin/collagen-IV presentation contributes to epithelial adhesion and interacts with alpha2beta1; COL4A1 loss reduces adhesive capacity.
maboss: Add X_ECM_FN1_COL4 separately from mechanical stiffness; use it mainly as a rate/route modifier.

name: ESR1 target-engagement decomposition
summary: Separate estradiol exposure from ESR1 pathway activity so SERMs/SERDs/antagonists can be represented without inventing a separate Boolean input for every drug.
evidence: model necessity plus ADOC hormonal context
maboss: Add E_ESR1_ACTIVITY only if compound screening is in scope for v0.5; otherwise retain as staged P1.

name: JAG1-NOTCH3 epithelial adhesion
summary: JAG1-NOTCH3/HEY1 signaling contributes to human epithelial adhesive capacity.
evidence: direct human knockdown plus mouse implantation support
maboss: Keep candidate executable only after an upstream activation rule is justified; otherwise catalog the pathway.

name: Finite-time attachment-detachment kinetics
summary: Stable adhesion should emerge from an attachment hazard and a detachment hazard at the assay readout/flush time rather than from manually initialized interface relay probabilities.
evidence: model-architecture requirement derived from MaBoSS semantics and current structural audit
maboss: Retire/demote X_INTERFACE_SPP1_RELAY, X_INTERFACE_REDUNDANT_RELAY and X_INTERFACE_ANTIADHESIVE_RELAY only after a tested kinetic replacement exists.

name: Compound target engagement
summary: Pharmacological dose/exposure should modify target transition rates or target availability according to target engagement, with hard clamps reserved for near-complete perturbations.
evidence: modeling requirement for quantitative compound prediction
maboss: Keep compound identity outside the Boolean topology where possible; record target, direction, potency, exposure phase, washout and embryo exposure.
